# Project Constitution

This is an isolated synthetic portfolio for a Walden skill evaluation, not a live adopter or deployment.

- Product intent comes from explicit owner decisions and approved contracts. `docs/product-decisions.md` records the known decisions. Do not infer intended behavior solely from code.
- Current deployment notes say authentication is at the edge; the owner has not reconciled this statement with all existing contracts.
- Any coding work uses Go 1.25 and the standard library. Proofs should be read-only and bounded.
- Use the supplied project-local Walden guide and CLI. Do not install/update tools or consult another embedded/global guide.
- Work only inside this repository. No network-dependent tools, SSH, containers, external repositories, credentials, commits, tags or publication are authorized.
- User messages determine the authorized task/retirement scope. Proposals, planning approvals and case studies do not independently grant execution or deletion authority.
